messages:
Sasha (HW Partnerships): Hey team — NexusEdge wants a reproducible perf/W + throughput run we can co-publish. Can we lock down a run protocol this week?
Evan (Perf Eng): I'm available. Need agreement on: power sensor placement, thermal stabilization window, kernel/build flags, and a minimal telemetry schema.
Priya (ML Applied): Also include the model + tokenization exactly (deterministic seed, batch shapes). Otherwise numbers are not comparable.
Rita (Solutions): NexusEdge legal asked for the announcement gating checklist too — they want the bench artifacts and the raw telemetry before any press.
Sasha (HW Partnerships): Good point. Proposal: 1) 4-hour thermal soak at target power, 2) three steady-state 15-min runs, 3) median reported, 4) perf/W measured with external power meter (IEC62301 style). Thoughts? :thinking_face:
Evan (Perf Eng): Sounds fair. For kernel flags: we standardize on these: `-O3 -march=native -ffast-math` (we will document exact compiler/toolchain versions). For GPU kernels, we should pin the driver and cu/cu-like runtime.
Priya (ML Applied): Model: LLaMA-2-7B (quantized to 4-bit as partner variant), prompt set: 500 sample prompts from our eval corpus, max_tokens=256, temperature=0.0. Batch shapes: [1,32,64] to surface different memory behaviors.
bench-bot: runbook-template.pdf uploaded to the shared drive: https://redwood.example/s/bench-runbook-nexusedge
Rita (Solutions): For telemetry schema — can we agree on a minimal JSON lines format: timestamp, sample_id, tokens_out, latency_ms_p50/p90/p99, power_w, gpu_temp_c, kernel_version, model_version. We can hand that to NexusEdge so they export matching logs.
Evan (Perf Eng): Yes. Example snippet we can share:
```
{"ts":"2026-02-13T14:05:02Z","sample":"s123","tokens":128,"p50":12.3,"p90":18.4,"p99":45.2,"power_w":312.5,"gpu_temp_c":72.1,"kernel":"5.18.0-rc","model":"llama2-7b-q4"}
```
Sasha (HW Partnerships): Nice. Who owns the run orchestration scripts? NexusEdge wants a runnable script they can execute on their lab image.
Evan (Perf Eng): I'll produce a minimal `run_nexus_bench.sh` that pulls our harness, pins CPU governor, sets fan to auto/manual, and runs the three batch shapes. Example command we will expose: `./run_nexus_bench.sh --model llama2-7b-q4 --prompts prompts.jsonl --out results.jsonl`
Priya (ML Applied): Add a deterministic seed flag and --no-async-io to keep latency variance small.
Rita (Solutions): For announcement gating: we need (a) raw telemetry, (b) runbook + scripts, (c) signed partner statement, (d) internal perf review sign-off. NexusEdge PR wants a 7-day review window.
Sasha (HW Partnerships): Timeline suggestion: Monday: hand off runbook & scripts; Tue-Wed: Partner executes; Thu: we ingest telemetry and run our verifier; Fri: sign-off and draft joint blog. Is that too aggressive?
Evan (Perf Eng): Tight but doable if NexusEdge schedules lab time. Add one more day for kernel retune if numbers deviate.
Priya (ML Applied): Also include a small evaluation check: run the same prompt set on our hosted instance to sanity-check outputs for regressions in quantization. Include exact commit hashes.
Sasha (HW Partnerships): Action items: Evan -> prepare run script + kernel flag doc by EOD; Priya -> export 500-sample prompt set and verifier; Rita -> draft announcement gating checklist and legal ask template; bench-bot -> create shared folder and ticket.
bench-bot: ticket #P-4387 created: "NexusEdge joint bench + artifacts". Link: https://pm.redwood.example/t/P-4387
Rita (Solutions): I'll ping NexusEdge PM (cc @nexus-pm) to confirm lab window and the 7-day review.
Evan (Perf Eng): One more technical note: we should include a kernel telem sample for KV cache warmup behavior. Add a warmup prefix of 64 tokens x 10 before measurements.
Priya (ML Applied): A/B test for quant: run both q4 and q8 variants if partner hardware supports it — gives a perf/W curve.
Sasha (HW Partnerships): Great. If everyone OK, I'll send the handoff email and schedule a 30-min sync with NexusEdge for Wed. :thumbsup:
Evan (Perf Eng): OK from perf.
Priya (ML Applied): OK from ML.
Rita (Solutions): OK from Solutions.
Sasha (HW Partnerships): Closing this thread — will post runbook link in channel when ready. Thanks! :rocket:
